lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cr2Mn4Cu4Se12 (reduced formula CrMn2(CuSe3)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr and Mn each adopt octahedral coordination by six Se atoms, while Cu also has six Se neighbors and Se is coordinated by one Cu and two Mn atoms. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cr and Mn octahedra, and edge-sharing between like Cr and Mn octahedra.
